links.targetTitle: BD planning — industry and companion-software selection (20 Aug 2026)

title: Companion software must be open source, already deployed in consultancy projects, and carry an ecosystem
content:
The stated criteria are that the complementary software "is sufficiently open-source", "is deployed within the consultancy projects", and "offers us an ecosystem that we can tap into".

Each does distinct work. Open source makes integration possible without a commercial negotiation and makes the gap inspectable. Deployment inside consultancy projects means the integration reaches clients through someone else's existing delivery motion. The ecosystem requirement is about reach: a partner directory or user community converts one integration into many conversations.

Together they define the shape of the play — Powerhouse attaches to software the consultancy already installs, so the consultancy is the channel and the end client is reached through it.
description: Three criteria for the complementary product Powerhouse integrates with — the deployment requirement is what makes the consultancy the channel rather than the client.
